title: YouTube TV is giving subscribers a $10 credit because the service went down — but you have only until Wednesday to claim it (GOOG, GOOGL, AAPL)
text: YouTube TV is giving subscribers a $10 credit because the service went down — but you have only until Wednesday to claim it (GOOG, GOOGL, AAPL) Monday, 22 October 2018 () · YouTube went down for an hour last week. · People who pay a monthly subscription for YouTube TV are being offered a free week of service or a $10 credit, depending on how they pay for the service. · If you were affected you have until Wednesday to apply for the credit.
